findings.text: mtime detection from a file object is only asserted as `last_modified is not None`; no test checks the value equals the file's mtime or that an ETag is generated for a file object, and no test checks that an explicit download_name overrides a named file's name.
The `path_name` temporary can be folded into one expression, e.g. `if download_name is None and isinstance(name, str): download_name = os.path.basename(name)`.

coverage.note: Reads a BytesIO and a real file to the end, then asserts the full data is sent. test_object_range (line 114) checks Content-Range and length after a partial read. test_object_detects_name_size_mtime (line 66) checks size.
Asserts the ETag equals exactly `"{mtime}-{size}"`, so a path hash would fail it.

A BytesIO with no name gives application/octet-stream instead of TypeError. Routing through apply_conditions/apply_range is exercised by test_etag_conditional_not_modified (line 155, 304) and test_path_range_and_accept_ranges (206).
